headline: Colombia Pension Reform Debate Centers on Fiscal Cost of High-Income Subsidies
summary: Experts in Colombia are raising concerns over the fiscal burden of counter-proposals to pension reform, warning against using public funds to subsidize pensions for higher-income retirees.
why: Colombia's fiscal deficit and sovereign debt ratings are closely tied to the long-term sustainability of its state pension liabilities.

entities.name: Ministry of Finance and Public Credit

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Unfunded pension commitments could widen the fiscal deficit and increase sovereign borrowing costs.
